what:
HTML leftovers decoded on the master sheet, 2026-09-30: 2,750 cells in 2,738 rows across 11 tabs. Finding 1 of the first master-list audit (MASTER_AUDIT_2026-09-30.md, rule text-entity: 2,734 rows on 10 item tabs), plus 4 Image URL cells on Train Tender Parts that the audit does not walk (Brad: yes, same fix). Written from the app in Brad's Chrome with his token via values:batchUpdate RAW: one cell first and read back, then the rest in batches; every cell read back equal to 'new'; every other cell on the 11 tabs read back unchanged; 0 entities left on those tabs. Nothing deleted, no other cell touched. Rules: & -> &, ' -> ', " -> ", ” -> ” (the two Lionel PW 2560 Original COTT Desc cells, as the source had it); the ten MTH O Descriptions and their Original Description twins that carried a stray

tag take the sibling rows' comma ("... - VIA Rail, Cab Nos. 6428"); one MTH O Variation Description that had already lost its leading & ("quot;O" Lamp") becomes "O" Lamp. Rows are [tab, item number (column A), column header, old cell, new cell, sheet row at the time - a hint only: the identity is tab + item number + column + old cell]. Master Version 1.87.
